---
name: prompt-library
description: Add a reusable animation prompt template to the academy only after its variables and platform assumptions are understood. Use when a validated prompt pattern should become teaching material. Do not use for one-off prompts that have not been tested or for unsupported platform syntax.
---

# Prompt library

- Start from a prompt pattern that has produced an acceptable result.
- Separate stable instructions from variables such as subject action camera duration and format.
- Record the model or platform context in which the template was validated.
- Include one worked example and one known limitation.
- Remove one-off private context and unlicensed asset references.
- Keep platform-specific syntax out of generic templates unless clearly labeled.
- Run lint and build after adding the template to the academy.
